Alex R: Quick async standup — SDKs / quickstarts / samples
What I did: landed sampleapp CI fix, pushed Node ESM quickstart, updated two doc snippets.
Blockers: failing macOS wheels in CI, need maintainer access to npm package.
Today: swap sampleapp to use new quickstart, open PR for wheel fix.

Alex R: thanks — will run after lunch.

Priya K: quick q — the Node quickstart uses `@redwood/sdk` v0.9. Should we bump to v1.0? there's a breaking change with auth.

Alex R: Good catch — left a note in PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/542

Taylor M: sampleapp's local dev sometimes returns 502s when loading models. stack trace shows `kv cache miss` followed by `ModelPullTimeout`.

Samir: 502s could be model pull timeouts. try exporting `REDWOOD_MODEL_TIMEOUT=60` before starting the dev server.

Alex R: ok trying that now. if it still fails i'll open an issue and ping @eng-runtime.

Docs Bot: PR #542 merged by Priya K — docs updated (auto).

Priya K: opened INF-1234 for npm publish access: https://tracker.redwood/INF-1234

Alex R: cool, thanks. no other blockers from me today. if someone can grant npm rights or pair on wheels i can close the loop. :thumbsup:
